name: Empty Recycle Bin
description: Permanently removes all files currently stored in the Recycle Bin to free up disk space immediately.

description_i18n.en: Permanently removes all files currently stored in the Recycle Bin to free up disk space immediately.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt dauerhaft alle Dateien im Papierkorb, um sofort Speicherplatz auf der Festplatte freizugeben.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime définitivement tous les fichiers stockés dans la Corbeille pour libérer de l'espace disque immédiatement.

warnings.title: Local data cleanup
warnings.message: Files currently stored in the Recycle Bin will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered after this action runs

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Calls the Windows SHEmptyRecycleBin API per available file-system drive without confirmation UI, with Clear-RecycleBin fallback and non-fatal handling for missing or unavailable recycle bin paths
